item.title: New James Bond Officially Joins The 007 Franchise Today
item.description: Ian Fleming's James Bond is set for a cinematic revival with director Denis Villeneuve's in-the-works feature film, currently known colloquially as Bond 26 . Casting for the new 007 is currently underway, with a half-dozen leading men in contention to succeed actor Daniel Craig, who retired as Bond in 2021's No Time To Die after starring in five franchise films.

item.title: How to get comms modules in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: Getting comms modules in DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a pain in the butt, because this epic-tier crafting ingredient is incredibly elusive if you don't know where to look. You need comms modules to unlock uncommon ingredient printing (along with high-tenacity fibers ), to increase your weapon storage, and for other equipment such as fulton drop markers . Once you've unlocked epic ingredient printing you can simply make more, but that's not feasible until you've acquired even rarer ingredients.

item.title: 'Pokémon' Officially Brings Back Long-Lost Rare Monster After 10 Years
item.description: The most elusive Pokémon probably aren't the ones you think. The list of unavailable Pokémon is full of monsters that sound ordinary but, for one reason or another, aren't obtainable. That's why fans are so excited about the new Pokémon Legends: Z-A challenge.

item.title: Netflix Officially Confirms PUBG TV Adaptation in the Works
item.description: Netflix has a long history of video game adaptations with series like Arcane , Castlevania , Resident Evil , and the upcoming Assassin's Creed live-action show , but the streaming service's latest project is a big surprise. Krafton and Netflix announced Thursday that PUBG , the enduring game that popularized the battle royale genre, is in development as a live-action television series for Netflix.

item.title: 'Rings of Power' Season 3 Will Introduce a Character That Subverts Tolkien’s Mythos
item.description: The Age of Men is over. The Age of the Orc Discourse has begun. In a recent interview with IGN about the upcoming season of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power , co-showrunner Patrick McKay said big changes are coming, including a five-year time skip . McKay went as far as to describe season 3 as a “soft reboot” of sorts. While that’s certainly a big deal, another line in the interview will stand out for many Tolkien-heads. The show will introduce “an Orc with an arc.”

item.title: James Gunn Finally Confirming What’s Official DCU Canon in The Suicide Squad
item.description: Ever since James Gunn was named co-head of DC Studios in 2022, the filmmaker has spent years answering fan questions about what past and current projects constitute the new DC Universe canon. One of the biggest points of contention is 2021's The Suicide Squad , which Gunn directed before the new DCU was a thing. Now he's finally going to give the definitive answer on exactly what from the film is canon, and you'll be able to watch the whole thing.

item.title: 'PUBG: Final Circle' Officially Revealed
item.description: PUBG: Battlegrounds has sent millions of players scrambling for weapons, scavenging for supplies, and fighting to be the last person standing. Now, the battle royale franchise is taking that familiar survival formula somewhere it has never gone before: the tabletop. PUBG: Final Circle is a card game where players must loot equipment, outmaneuver their opponents, and survive a series of increasingly dangerous encounters.

item.title: Best Guns in the Modern Warfare 4 Beta
item.description: The best guns in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 are exactly what you should be using if you want to be part of the meta right now. This is one of the best Call of Duty multiplayer experiences in a long time, and with a vast array of guns to choose from, you can dominate the skill-based matchmaking and improve your kill-death ratio.

item.title: BioWare Co-Founder Breaks Down the Problem With AI in Game Development Perfectly
item.description: When Electronic Arts decided to shutter legendary RPG studio BioWare on Oct. 21, Greg Zeschuk, one of BioWare's co-founders alongside Ray Muzyka and Augustine Yip, found out through a flurry of text messages. In an interview with 80 Level , Zeschuk revealed that shortly after the news broke and he went home, his feelings about the closure were fairly muted.
